savvan.bio: Sawan Kanota, professionally known as savvan, is a Canadian producer, multi-instrumentalist, saxophonist, music director and film composer from the Greater Toronto Area. Working across R&B, pop and hip-hop, he combines Western and Eastern musical traditions through production, performance and engineering. His production and performance on Divine Lightbody's 2025 track nightlife is his Northern Dial library credit.

jimmy prime.bio: Jimmy Prime is a Toronto rapper and member of the Prime Boys who became closely identified with the city's 2010s hip-hop rise. Raised in Toronto and embedded in the Prime collective, he is widely credited with helping popularize The 6 as a nickname for the city. His appearance alongside SAFE on Smoke Dawg's YND is his Northern Dial library credit.

twotiime.bio: TwoTiime is an Ottawa rapper, singer and songwriter whose melodic street-rap combines hard-edged storytelling with emotionally direct hooks. He first drew national attention with Hood Cry and went on to build an Ottawa-rooted catalogue while expanding beyond the city's scene. Hood Cry, How I'm Comin and Up2Me are his three Northern Dial library credits.

nonso amadi.bio: Nonso Amadi is a Nigerian-born, Toronto-based Afro-R&B singer, songwriter and producer whose music blends contemporary R&B, soul, Afrobeats and alté influences. After moving to Canada, he developed a cross-continental career that has included a JUNO nomination and releases through Universal Music Canada. DROWN from his 2025 EP TO CRY A FLOOD is his Northern Dial library credit.

chanhays.bio: ChanHays is a Halifax, Nova Scotia producer and DJ whose boom-bap production has connected Atlantic Canada's hip-hop scene with rappers from across North America. His catalogue includes the albums Here and The Creepy as well as the Boldy James collaboration Prisoner of Circumstance, released through Halifax-based Droppin' Science Productions. Get Ahead with Aquakultre and Ghettosocks is his Northern Dial library credit.
